question: Why does the Lord say he supports the world with one part?
premises: The Lord supports the whole world with one part.
This prevents an exclusive distinction that would break the vision of Brahman.
All this is the Lord's principle manifested in various forms.
inference: The Lord's one-part support preserves nonexclusive divine pervasion.
uncertainties: Editorial markers and fused compounds in this long prose span are glossed as wholes.
plain_english: Or else, what is the use of much knowledge for you, Arjuna? Supporting this whole world, I stand with one part. I am the Self. This teaching prevents a distinction that would otherwise break the vision of Brahman; all this is the Lord's principle, manifested in various forms and becoming the object of all.
